conclusion: Full ASAM .2 model learns true own-history (.9951/.9968) and dynamic same-time peer (.7783/.7827). Pure unlabelled donor lagged/context fail: precision and current-core bypass do not resolve this. With identical inputs/recipient targets and added donor own-signal supervision, lagged learns (.9475/.9557 versus uniform -.0110/.3438 and own-only -.0278 on seed11). Joint context learns both regimes on both seeds (.8601/.8573 overall; current .7587/.7541, historical .9616/.9513; uniform .0131/.0135 overall; own-only -.0002 at4096 seed11). Accept this conditional full-model learning capability as sufficient to proceed to registered financial calibration. Do not call the pure unlabelled task passed, universal attention success, or financial alpha. SAM controls did not achieve the ASAM toy results. Budgets and supervision changes are post-hoc diagnoses disclosed in the registration; all54 attempts retained.
